summary: Bonner County, ID 40-foot L-4 pole tower, built 1933-35 (sources differ), used for fire detection to 1950, torn down or destroyed 1961-63. An undated WillhiteWeb photo caption says the summit has many towers; no source names them.

sources.title: Welcome to Little Blacktail Ranch Park

notes_for_editor: Dates disagree: built 1933 (Forest Lookouts, WillhiteWeb), 1934 (Idaho Fire Lookouts), 1935 (firelookout.com); destroyed 1961 (two 1961 newspaper items quoted by Forest Lookouts, WillhiteWeb) vs 1963 (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts). Forest name also disagrees (Kaniksu vs Coeur d'Alene); the record keeps Kaniksu. An undated WillhiteWeb photo caption says the summit has many towers, but no source names them or says whether the microwave station remains. Nothing says whether the summit is public. The HOA site is cited only for context on private homesites on the slope. No photos of the lookout found. Built event added to the record.
